hook.es: ¿Y si Opsly no solo administrara negocios, sino que ayudara a crearlos?
hook.en: What if Opsly didn't just run businesses, but helped create them?

objective: The Traveler realizes the platform could generalize beyond running client businesses (academies, tourism, construction, restaurants, content) into a way of turning any idea into a testable venture — Blueprint -> Tenant -> Experiment -> Market. This mirrors his own lifelong habit of imagining things and trying to build them.

scenes.description: New seed-worlds branch from the blueprint
scenes.visuals: From the central Opsly structure, small new seed-shapes begin branching off — an academy, tourism, construction, a restaurant, content
scenes.copy: ¿Y si Opsly no solo administrara negocios, sino que ayudara a crearlos?

scenes.visuals: Each seed-world sits along a glowing branching path labeled in sequence

scenes.description: The Traveler recognizes himself in it
scenes.visuals: The Traveler looking at the branching seed-worlds, a faint echo of his own many-lives portals (Episode 2) flickering behind them
scenes.copy: Por primera vez, la plataforma empezó a parecerse a él.

scenes.visuals: NØVA bouncing excitedly among the seed-worlds; The Traveler more measured, watchful
scenes.copy: NØVA quería entrar en todos. The Traveler recordó la pregunta de siempre: ¿esto es real, o es otra idea más?

scenes.visuals: The branching path continuing off-screen, not resolved, still growing
scenes.copy: Imaginar algo y tratar de convertirlo en realidad. Esto todavía está pasando.

metadata.call_to_action: Imaginar algo y tratar de convertirlo en realidad.

captions.es: Cuando la plataforma empieza a parecerse a ti.
captions.en: When the platform starts to look like you.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler standing at a junction where many small glowing seed-worlds (academy, tourism, construction, restaurant, content) branch off from a single blueprint structure

notes: Act IX of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.
Theme: the platform's architecture becomes a mirror of The Traveler's own personality — someone who imagines many things and tries to build them.

Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 09. This is a forward-looking/aspirational concept as of 2026-08-11 — do not present specific ventures as launched facts unless already true and documented elsewhere.
This episode is explicitly framed as present-tense/ongoing, consistent with the season's open ending (Episode 13, 'The Map').
